run_bm_lighting: run the bm_lighting benchmark to measure diffuse and specular lighting performance on CUDA GPU
run_bm_diffuse_cuda_with_init: run the _bm_diffuse_cuda_with_init function to benchmark diffuse lighting with random normals, color, and direction tensors
run_bm_specular_cuda_with_init: run the _bm_specular_cuda_with_init function to benchmark specular lighting with points, normals, camera position, and shininess
test_bm_lighting: test the bm_lighting module by running it as a script to benchmark lighting on available CUDA devices
review_bm_lighting: review the bm_lighting benchmark to understand test cases across batch sizes, spatial dimensions, and face counts
